description:
HushTelegram v0.0.26 targets Telegram 13.2.2, both telegram.org's build (org.telegram.messenger.web, version code 73039) and the Google Play build (org.telegram.messenger, version code 73031), with 82 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. Nearly all of what's new came from your reports. Call recording gets a record and pause button on the call screen, its own folder and a notification when a call's saved. Forwarding out of protected channels works now, the settings come in Simplified Chinese, and there's a long list of smaller switches from #79. Every new switch starts off.

If Telegram turns down your login code with API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, that's it refusing the public API ID every patched build carries, the Play one included. Register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 2802 runtime tests passed. On the patch side, 742 patch tests passed and all 82 patches applied to both 13.2.2 builds. Both patched builds were walked signed in on an Android 13 emulator with no crashes.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer, since this bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.4.0 and older Managers won't load it. Patch 13.2.2 from Google Play or from telegram.org's Download button. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from 0.0.25, patch the same build and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same signing key. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** Both builds move from Telegram 13.2.1 to 13.2.2, code 73031 from Google Play and 73039 from telegram.org.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, the one in Morphe Manager 2.6.0 and morphe-desktop 2.2.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.6.0 or newer before you add this release.
* **Telegram:** **Save downloaded files** has a new switch, **File icons and thumbnails**, off by default. An APK or EXE sent as a file gets an Android-style or Windows-style icon of its own in Shared media's Files tab, and in the chat once it's downloaded. A downloaded PDF shows its first page in both places and a downloaded video a frame from it, made in the background. Files with a thumbnail from Telegram keep it, and anything not downloaded yet keeps Telegram's icon. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Disable draft link previews** has a new switch, **Fix link previews**, off by default. A link you send gets its preview from another site by the rules in **Link preview rules**, one rule per line, and the message keeps the link you typed. The rules start with posts on X, TikTok, Reddit and Instagram plus everything on pixiv. A rule can name a path, like `x.com/*/status -> fixupx.com`, with `*` for any one part, so a profile link keeps Telegram's own preview instead of the fixer site's page. Secret chats, edits and bot results keep Telegram's own preview. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Ask before sending a sticker** has two new questions, each with its own switch and each off by default. **Ask before sending a message** asks Send or Cancel when the send button or the keyboard's send key would send what you typed, and Cancel leaves the text, its reply and its link preview where they were. Scheduled and silent messages, edits and forwards still go out without asking. **Ask before joining a voice chat** asks Join or Cancel before you join a group's voice chat or a channel's live stream, and starting a new one doesn't ask. Round video messages also get their own switch, **Ask before sending a round video message**, apart from **Ask before sending a voice message**. If you had the old voice and video question on, both stay on. (#79)
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram's settings come in Simplified Chinese. With Telegram or the phone set to Chinese (Simplified), every HushTelegram page, switch, dialog and message shows in Chinese. (#80)
* **Telegram:** **Your own chat list title** is a new switch in Look and feel, under **Emoji next to the chat list title**, off by default. Type a name of up to 24 characters in **Text for the chat list title** and it shows at the top of the chat list in place of "Telegram", in the title's own bold font and theme color, after a restart. Leave the text empty to get Telegram's name back. It lives on this phone only and goes along with settings export and import. (#86)
* **Telegram:** **Hide pinned message bar** is a new switch under **Hide translate bar**, off by default. It takes away the bar under a chat's top bar that shows pinned messages, with its counter and list button, and the chat moves up into the space. The messages stay pinned and nothing gets marked as read. Flip it with a chat open behind the settings and that chat's bar goes or comes back as soon as you're back in it. (#85)
* **Telegram:** **Record calls** has three new rows under it. **Calls to record** picks every call, private calls only, voice chats and live streams only, or just the chats you pick. Pick those in **Chats to record**, or long press chats in the chat list and use **Record calls here** in the three dots menu. **Keep recordings** can delete recordings older than 7, 30 or 90 days each time a new one is saved, and it only ever touches the call recordings HushTelegram made. Recordings are named after the person or group now, like "Telegram call with Alex Kim 2026-11-12 14-05.m4a". (#72)
* **Telegram:** While **Record button on calls** is recording, the button shows how long the recording runs and a pause button sits next to it. Whatever is said during a pause stays out of the file, and the call still saves as one recording. A tap on the record button records the call you're on even when **Calls to record** would skip it. (#72)
* **Telegram:** **Notify when a call is saved** puts up a notification after each recording. Tap it to play the recording, or use its buttons to share it or send it straight to your Saved Messages. It's off until you turn it on, and it needs Android 10 or newer. (#72)
* **Telegram:** **Save recordings as Opus** saves calls as .ogg files about half the size of the usual .m4a. It's there on Android 10 and newer, and a phone that can't write Opus keeps saving .m4a. (#72)
* **Telegram:** **Recordings folder** lets you pick any folder on the phone for call recordings. Keep recordings cleans that folder too. If Telegram loses access to it, say after the folder's deleted, recordings go back to the usual folder until you pick another one. (#72)
* **Telegram:** **Record button on calls** shows on voice chats and live streams too, at the start of the row of buttons in the top right corner. It records and pauses there the same way it does on a call. (#72)
* **Telegram:** **Delete account** on the Privacy page deletes the account you're signed in with, right from the app. It asks first. When the account has a cloud password, Telegram waits a week before it deletes anything. (#71)
* **Telegram:** **Show all spoilers and quotes**, under **Reveal spoilers**, adds two items to a chat's menu at the top. **Show all spoilers** uncovers every spoiler in the messages loaded so far, as if you'd tapped each one, and **Expand all quotes** opens every collapsed quote. View-once and sensitive media keep their blur. (#71)
* **Telegram:** With **Open quotes on search hits** on, a chat search that lands on a match inside a collapsed quote opens the quote, so the match Telegram highlights is right there to see. (#71)
* **Telegram:** **Select all** sits next to **Select between** under **Add Repeat to the message menu**, off by default. It puts a Select all button in the bar that shows while you pick messages, both in a chat and in a chat's shared media (photos, files, voice messages, links, music and GIFs). One tap selects everything loaded there, newest first, up to Telegram's 100 message limit. (#73)
* **Telegram:** **Skip between voice messages** is a new switch under **Voice messages in the music player**, off by default. With it on, next and previous on headphones, in a car, in the notification, on the lock screen and in the full player move through a chat's voice messages the way they do through songs. Previous starts the message over when it's been playing for more than 3 seconds, and goes back one when it hasn't. Songs and view-once messages keep Telegram's own buttons. (#77)
* **Telegram:** With **Read receipts button** on, every chat's menu at the top has a **Send read receipts** item too. It sends the read receipt Ghost mode is holding for that chat only, so one person sees you've read their messages and nobody else does. (#69)
* **Telegram:** With **Read receipts button** on, a long press on a folder tab shows **Send read receipts** right under **Mark all as read**. While Ghost mode holds your reads, Mark all as read only clears the badges on this phone. This one sends them, so your other devices catch up. (#65)
* **Telegram:** **Keep my messages too** sits under **Keep deleted messages**, off by default. When someone deletes a whole chat for both of you, your own messages stay along with theirs instead of only theirs. Messages you delete on another of your devices stay on this phone too. (#82)
* **Telegram:** **Remove kept messages after** sits under **Clear kept messages**. Pick 1, 7, 30 or 90 days and a kept message goes away on its own that long after it was deleted, the same way Clear kept messages removes it. It's set to **Never** by default, so nothing changes until you pick. Messages kept before this update start counting after it, so none of them disappear the moment you pick. (#91)
* **Telegram:** **Also save from secret chats** is a new switch under **Save downloaded files**, off by default. Together with **Also save from chats that don't allow saving**, files, photos and videos from secret chats get copied to Download/Telegram as well, and the message menu's **Save to Downloads** shows up there. Their view-once and timed media also need **Also save view-once and timed media**. (#82)
* **Telegram:** **Also allow screenshots in secret chats** sits under **Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving**, off by default. With both on, screenshots and screen recording work in secret chats, their photos and their profiles. Telegram may still tell the other person when you take one. (#82)
* **Telegram:** **Keep self-destructing secret chat messages** sits under **Keep deleted messages**, off by default. Messages, photos and videos in a secret chat stay on your phone when their self-destruct timer runs out. The other person's copy still goes on their own timer. (#82)
* **Telegram:** With **Open restricted channels** on, the alert Telegram shows when a public channel has banned you gets an **Open on the web** button. It opens the channel's page at t.me/s/ in your browser, where its posts still show to anyone. The button shows only when HushTelegram knows the channel's public name, from the channel itself or from the link that brought you to it. (#71)
* **Telegram:** **Keep chats you're removed from** sits under **Keep deleted messages**, off by default. When a group or channel removes or bans you, it stays in your chat list with the messages this phone already saved. Opening it shows a short note instead of Telegram's alert, and you can scroll back through it but not post. Delete it from the chat list when you're done and it's gone for good. Chats you leave yourself work as usual. (#71)
* **Telegram:** **Message details** lists more about a file. You get its name and MIME type, the resolution of a photo or video, and the length and average bitrate of a song, voice message or video. Telegram doesn't send a bitrate, so it's worked out from the file's size and length. A line with nothing to show is left out. (#87)
* **Telegram:** **Check Also delete for by default** is a new switch under **Add Repeat to the message menu**, off by default. With it on, the Also delete for box in Telegram's delete dialog starts checked, so messages you delete in a chat with a person go for both of you. Groups, channels, secret chats and Saved Messages don't change, since Telegram doesn't offer the box there. Uncheck it in the dialog to delete just for you. (#83)
* **Telegram:** **Device in Active sessions**, on the Privacy page under **Don't notify contacts**, sets the device name and system version your other phones and computers see for this one in Settings > Devices. Leave a box empty and Telegram's own goes out. A change shows after you restart Telegram. (#79)
* **Telegram:** With **Ghost mode** keeping read receipts back, a long press on a message someone sent you offers **Send read receipt**. They see that message, and the ones before it, as read, while Ghost mode stays on for everything else. It works in chats with people, groups and supergroups. Channels already send their reads, and secret chats aren't covered. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Show when an account was made** is a new switch under **Show user and chat IDs**, off by default. A person's profile menu then shows about which month they joined Telegram, such as "Registered about March 2016", right under the ID row. The month is worked out on the phone from the user ID and a table of IDs with publicly known sign-up dates, so it's an estimate and nothing is asked of Telegram. An account newer than the table reads "Registered after" its last month. Bots, groups and channels get no row, and tapping the row copies it. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Show when members joined** is a new switch under **Show user and chat IDs**, off by default. A group's member list on its profile and its Members page then add when each person joined to the line under their name, such as "last seen recently · joined 12 Mar 2024, 14:05", written the way your phone writes dates. The date already comes with the list, so nothing more is asked of Telegram. Admins and the owner keep their role there, and a member Telegram sends no date for shows nothing extra. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Show when forwards were first sent** is a new switch under **Show user and chat IDs**, off by default. A forwarded message's header then adds when the original was sent, such as "Forwarded from · 12 Mar 2024, 14:05", written the way your phone writes dates. In compact chats the date goes after the sender's name in the one-line header. The date already comes with the message, so nothing more is asked of Telegram, and messages that aren't forwards look the same as before. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Pin chats on this phone** is a new switch on the Chat list page under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default. A long press in the chat list then offers **Pin on this phone** in the three dots menu, and **Unpin on this phone** once every chat you picked is pinned that way. Those chats sit right under Telegram's own pinned chats in All Chats, newest message first, up to 20 of them. Nothing goes to Telegram, so the pin limit, your server pins and your other devices stay as they are. The archive and the folder tabs keep Telegram's order, and the list goes along in a settings file. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Change avatar size** is a new switch on the Chat list page under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default. Chat pictures in the chat list show at the size you pick in **Avatar size** right below it, from 70% to 120% of Telegram's. Every row keeps its height and its text, and the picture stays centered in its spot, with the story ring, online dot and rounded corners following it. Turning it on or picking another size changes the chats already on screen right away. The size goes along in a settings file. (#89)
* **Telegram:** **Hide Contacts tab** has one more switch on the Chat list page, **Outline the bottom bar**, off by default. It draws a thin line in Telegram blue around the bar at the bottom of the main screen, so the bar stands out on AMOLED black and other dark themes. Telegram's other glass panels keep their look. Restart Telegram after flipping it. (#90)
* **Telegram:** **Do Not Disturb in the chat list menu** is a new switch on the Chat list page under **Proxy in the chat list menu**, off by default. The menu at the top of the chat list then ends with **Turn on Do Not Disturb**, and one tap there silences every message notification until you tap **Turn off Do Not Disturb**. A short toast says which way it went. While it's on, nothing new shows, sounds or vibrates for private chats, groups, channels, mentions or bots, and a message coming into the chat you have open makes no sound either. Messages still arrive and unread counts still go up. Calls ring as usual. Turning it off, or pausing HushTelegram, brings Telegram's notifications back with the next message, and a settings file never carries whether it's on. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Picture behind the lists** is a new switch on the Look and feel page under **AMOLED black**, off by default. Pick a photo in **Background picture** and it shows behind the chat list, Settings, profiles, contacts, calls and the other list pages, with the rows see-through over it. You choose how dim it is, from 20 to 80 percent. Chats keep their own wallpaper, and menus, dialogs, sheets, the keyboard panel and the media viewer stay solid. The photo is copied into Telegram's own files, so it stays after a restart or an account switch, and **Remove background** puts Telegram's look back right away. It works with Telegram's built-in themes and needs Android 13 or newer, so older phones don't show the two rows. A settings file carries the switch and the dim but not the photo. (#88)
* **Telegram:** **Chat list banner** is a new choice on the Look and feel page under **Your own chat list title**, off by default. Pick one of five color pairs (Dusk, Ocean, Forest, Ember or Slate) or a photo from your gallery, and the bar at the top of the chat list shows it. The colors switch with a light or dark theme so the title and icons stay easy to read, and a photo sits under a light veil for the same reason. Only the chat list's own bar changes. Folder tabs and the bar shrinking as you scroll work as before, and **None** puts Telegram's bar back right away. A settings file carries the choice but not the photo. (#86)
* **Telegram:** **Add Bookmark to the message menu** is a new switch under **Add Repeat to the message menu** on the Conversations page, off by default. Long press any message, post, photo, video or file and tap **Bookmark** to keep a note of it on this phone. While it's saved the item reads **Remove bookmark**. The **Bookmarks** page, right below the switch and in the chat list's side menu, lists them newest first with the chat's name, a short preview and the date. Tap one and its chat opens at that message, highlighted the way a reply jump does it, and a long press or the Remove button takes it off the list. If the message is gone or you've left the chat, it tells you. The list keeps up to 100 bookmarks, nothing goes to Telegram, and settings export and import carry them, adding a file's bookmarks to the ones already on the phone. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Use system font** can now draw all of Telegram's text in a font file of your own. Tap **Font file**, right under the switch, and pick a .ttf or .otf file from your phone. Picking one turns **Use system font** on, and the font shows after a restart. Most fonts come with one weight, so bold text is that font drawn thicker. Code blocks keep a monospace face, and Telegram's digit and Instant View faces stay as they are. Tap the row again to choose another font or remove it. The file stays on this phone and isn't part of settings export. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Admin tools** is a new switch under **My messages** on the Conversations page, off by default. A group or channel you own or manage then has **Admin tools** in its menu at the top. It lists Recent Actions, Administrators, Members (Subscribers in a channel), Permissions or Removed Users, and Invite Links, as far as your rights there go, and each one opens Telegram's own screen. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Admin folder** is a new switch under **Folders by chat type** on the Chat list page, off by default. Turning it on makes an ordinary Telegram folder called Admin with every group and channel you own or manage, so it's a tab above your chats here and on your other devices. While it's on, the folder keeps up as you gain or lose rights somewhere, about once a minute at most. Turning it off removes the folder, unless you renamed it or changed what's in it. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Voice changer** is a new choice on the Playback page, under **Play voice messages one at a time**, and it starts off. Pick Baby, Woman, Man, Horror movie or Robot, and the voice messages you record come out in that voice, waveform and all. It covers both of Telegram's voice recorders, and a recording keeps the voice it started with. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Add Edit a copy to the message menu** is a new switch under **Add Repeat to the message menu** on the Conversations page, off by default. Long press a photo that's on your phone and tap **Edit a copy** to open it in Telegram's own photo editor, where you can draw on it or blur the parts you don't want to share. Sending from the editor posts the edited copy to the same chat, and the photo you started from stays as it was. It only shows in chats you can send to that also allow forwarding. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Audio track and subtitles** is a new switch under **Start videos without sound** on the Playback page, off by default. A video's settings menu, the one with Loop video, then offers **Audio track** when the video has more than one, and **Subtitles** when it has any. Pick a track and the video switches to it, and the list keeps it ticked even after the video loops. Subtitles show as lines near the bottom of the video, and **Off** hides them again. A video with one audio track and no subtitles keeps Telegram's menu as it is. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **Recognize files you already have** is a new switch under Save downloaded files on the Playback page, off by default. A file, photo or video Telegram already downloaded, in another account for example, shows as downloaded and opens right away when Telegram's folders hold one with the same name and size. Telegram's servers don't send a fingerprint of a file, so name and size are what it goes by, the same check Telegram makes itself when you tap download. With **Keep Telegram's files in internal storage** on, files from before a reinstall count too. (#79)
* **Telegram:** With **Ask before sending a round video message** on, Cancel keeps the video you just recorded in the chat bar, paused, so you can still send it or delete it. The question used to come up only after Telegram had let go of the recording, which left an empty bar. Sending from a locked recording's send button asks too, and a clip too short for Telegram to keep no longer gets a question. (#79)
* **Telegram:** A suggestion card in Settings, like "Is this still your number?", goes away as soon as you answer it. Telegram 13.2's new Settings page listened for those changes in a place Telegram never sends them, so the card stayed until you left Settings and came back. Changes to your name or photo show there right away now too. (#76)
* **Telegram:** With `Hide phone number` on, the "Is this still your number?" card shows your real number, since you can't answer it about a row of dots. Your profile and the rest of Settings keep it covered. (#76)
* **Telegram:** Turning `Hide phone number` on or off changes the number at the top of Settings and on the Profile tab right away. Telegram 13.2 keeps its Settings tab built, so the number up there kept its old look until Telegram restarted.
* **Telegram:** With **Bypass channel restrictions** on, a forward out of a channel or chat that turns forwarding off now arrives. Telegram's servers turn those forwards down whatever the app says, so HushTelegram sends each message again as a new one instead, its text or its photo, video or file with the caption. They go out as your own messages, without the "Forwarded from" line. A video or file that isn't on the phone yet downloads first. Auto-forwarding rules that watch a protected chat go the same way. (#73, #94, #95)
* **Telegram:** Files now go out with **Forward as copy** and with a forward out of a protected chat. Telegram won't send a file from the app's private storage, which is where the renamed copy was made, so a PDF or any other document stopped at "Unsupported attachment". The copy now sits in the app's cache on shared storage, next to Telegram's own downloads. (#46, #94)
* **Telegram:** With **Bypass channel restrictions** on, Forward, Copy, Save to Gallery and the Share button show up on protected messages and work. That goes for the bar you get while picking messages, the message menu, shared media and the photo viewer. The switch only answered Telegram's chat-wide check before. Each protected message carries its own lock too, and a few screens read the channel's lock straight off the channel, so Forward on a post from a protected channel or a message a bot protected did nothing and Copy and Save stayed hidden. Private chats that turned forwarding off are covered as well. (#73)
* **Telegram:** **Your proxy lists** reads messier lists now. A link counts wherever it sits on a line, inside markdown like `[name](link)` or with two on one line. Stars, brackets, emoji or text right after a link no longer lose it, and neither does a server name ending in a dot or a secret written in standard base64. A list served as one block of base64 is decoded first. On a public list of 420 links that used to lose 58 of them, only the 8 with a broken port or a cut-off secret get skipped. **Find free proxies now** also says how many proxies were read, as in "10 of 406 read". (#78)
* **Telegram:** **Translate with an outside service** keeps a message's formatting. Bold, italic, quotes and links follow the words they were on in the translation, and custom emoji and @mentions come back exactly as written. A spoiler's words don't go to the service at all. They stay covered and in the original language, where the plain-text translation used to show them uncovered.
* **Telegram:** "Couldn't save the chats" fits in two lines again in Bulgarian, German, Spanish, Indonesian and Portuguese. It ran onto a third line on a small phone.
* **Telegram:** The German "Couldn't save that. Try again." toast is shorter and fits in two lines on a small phone. It used to run onto a third.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches.description: Forwards new messages others send in one chat to another by rules you set, every message or only messages with media. A forward from any account you're signed in to is never forwarded again, so rules can't loop, and at most 20 go out a minute. Starts off. Turn it on and add rules in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Bot token sign-in
patches.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them, and offers a channel that banned you on the web. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Chat preview buttons
patches.description: Adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under a chat you press and hold, so the preview opens fully or goes away with one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode, Power off accounts, Instant lock and Don't notify contacts also live, all off by default.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable pull to archive
patches.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable update checks
patches.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Exact numbers
patches.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Faster downloads
patches.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. A fifth, Send photos and videos in the best quality, sends photos in HD and videos at their own size unless you lower one first. All five start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Folders by chat type
patches.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Free proxies
patches.description: Downloads a public list of MTProto proxies, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list, refreshed every 6 hours. Telegram connects through them unless you use a proxy of your own. The phone number screen also always has the proxy button, so you can add one before you sign in, and Proxy order puts Telegram's proxy list in an order of your own, with pinned proxies on top. Finding proxies starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide Send as button
patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. More switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones. Disable secret chats ignores it when someone asks for a secret chat, with no answer sent back.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, from the forward preview, the Share sheet or the chat picker when you pick several chats, so copies arrive without the original author. You can still turn it off in the preview or the Share sheet's send menu. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.

HushTelegram colors is the blue badge. The plain styles draw just the H and plane, white on black or black on white, on Android 8 and up. Every style keeps the themed icon on Android 13. Telegram's own icon leaves Telegram's icon as it is, so only the app name changes.

patches.name: HushTelegram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon or the Telegram title at the top of the chat list. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Keep captions with their photos
patches.description: When you remove or reorder photos that each have a caption in the attach menu, every caption stays with its own photo instead of moving to the new first photo. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Lyrics and song dates
patches.description: Adds Lyrics to the music player's menu, found on lrclib.net and scrolling along with the song, and shows when you added each song to your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Message times with seconds
patches.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: My messages
patches.description: Adds My messages to a group's menu at the top, which searches the group for the messages you sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Never send an uncropped photo
patches.description: When Telegram can't finish cropping a photo, keeps the editor open and asks you to try again instead of sending the photo uncropped. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Proxy in the chat list menu
patches.description: Keeps Proxy in the chat list's menu, which Telegram only shows while a proxy is on or where Telegram is blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Repair Firebase push registration

If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. While Keep-Alive Service is on, it runs with a quiet notification so Android doesn't stop it in the background. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Reveal spoilers
patches.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Save downloaded files
patches.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. A third, Special contacts, adds Track this user to a person's profile menu and keeps a history of their status and profile changes on this phone. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, Clean links when you copy or paste, does the same for a link you copy or paste into the message box. A third, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. All start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches.name: Suppress screenshot notification
patches.description: Stops Telegram from telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Test server sign-in
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Test Backend box on the sign-in screen for every new account. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Text direction
patches.description: Adds Right to left, Left to right and Control character to the text menu of the message box, so you can set which way a line reads or add an invisible Unicode mark. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Translate with an outside service
patches.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself, so messages keep coming while Telegram is closed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Unlock Premium features
patches.description: Makes Telegram on your phone treat your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks behind Premium open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits, like upload size, stay the same. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. A second switch, Mention by ID, turns @ and a user ID typed in the message box into a real mention of people the app has already seen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

options.description: A Google Maps key for Android apps, made in your own Google Cloud project. Limit it to Telegram's package name and your signing certificate (SHA-1).

patches.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

options.description: The number shown as App api_id at my.telegram.org/apps. Fill in the API hash too, or leave both empty.
The 32-character code shown as App api_hash at my.telegram.org/apps. Keep it private, and fill in the API ID too.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. A second switch gives voice messages next and previous in the notification, on the lock screen and on headphones. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches.description: Forwards new messages others send in one chat to another by rules you set, every message or only messages with media. A forward from any account you're signed in to is never forwarded again, so rules can't loop, and at most 20 go out a minute. Starts off. Turn it on and add rules in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Bot token sign-in
patches.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them, and offers a channel that banned you on the web. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Chat preview buttons
patches.description: Adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under a chat you press and hold, so the preview opens fully or goes away with one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode, Power off accounts, Instant lock and Don't notify contacts also live, all off by default.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

release_notes:
HushTelegram v0.0.25 has 82 patches for Telegram 13.2.1, both the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72911) and telegram.org's (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72919), so the two builds are on the same version now. It's still on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, and Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer is all you need. The bundle is signed from this release on, so Morphe Manager shows who signed it when you add or update the source. Most of it came from your reports, and it changes something for #7, #27, #46, #48, #52, #58, #63, #65, #66, #67, #70 and #71. Free proxies keeps the fastest public MTProto proxies in Telegram's list for you. Ghost mode can make exceptions for the chats you pick, and the message menu gains Hide for me, Delete for them and Forward as plain text. Every new switch starts off, except the two that stop a photo from going out uncropped or with the wrong caption.

New in this release

- `Free proxies`, under Chat list. Turn it on and HushTelegram downloads a public list of MTProto proxies every 6 hours, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list. Telegram connects through the fastest and moves to another by itself when one stops answering, unless you're using a proxy of your own. `Find free proxies now` runs it right away, even with the switch off, and then only adds them to the list. Proxies you saved yourself are never touched. The phone number screen also always has Telegram's proxy button now, so you can add a proxy before you sign in, which helps where Telegram is blocked (#66).

- `Proxy order`, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Drag your proxies into the order you like or pin a few on top, and Telegram's own proxy screen lists them that way instead of re-sorting by speed every time it saves. A free proxy you pin becomes yours, so the next refresh won't remove it. `Sort by speed` drops your order and keeps only the pins. With HushTelegram paused the screen goes back to Telegram's order (#71).

- `Your proxy lists`, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Add the https addresses of up to 5 proxy lists you trust, pages of t.me/proxy or tg://proxy links, and Free proxies reads those instead of the public list, timing them all together and keeping the 10 fastest. A list that can't be read is skipped. Empty the box to go back to the public list. The addresses stay out of settings files (#71).

- `Proxy in the chat list menu`, under Chat list and off by default. The menu at the top of the chat list always has Proxy, so your saved proxies are one tap away. Telegram only puts it there while a proxy is on or in a country where Telegram is blocked (#67).

- `Ghost mode` has two new switches in Privacy, both off by default. `Read after you reply` sends the read receipt Ghost mode held back in a chat once you send a message there, so your other devices stop showing that chat as unread. `Read receipts button` puts a double check at the top of the chat list that sends every read receipt Ghost mode is holding for the account you're on. Held receipts last until Telegram restarts.

- `Ghost mode exceptions`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. The chats you pick get the opposite of Ghost mode: while it's on they read, type and watch stories as usual, and while it's off they keep back what the Ghost mode switches keep back, view counts included. Pick them in `Exception chats`, or long press chats in the chat list and use `Ghost mode exception` in the three dots menu. Online status isn't one chat's, so it follows Ghost mode everywhere (#71).

- `Fake typing`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. Long press chats in the chat list and pick `Fake typing` in the three dots menu, and they show you typing for 10 minutes or until you pick them again. It works with Ghost mode on too. Secret chats can't show it (#71).

- `Instant lock`, in Privacy and off by default. With a Telegram passcode set, Telegram locks a second or two after you leave it instead of waiting out your Auto-lock time. Your Auto-lock choice stays as it is and comes back when you turn the switch off.

- `Don't notify contacts`, in Privacy and off by default. When you sign up a phone number that's never used Telegram, the people who have it saved don't get the "joined Telegram" notice. Turn it on before you sign up. On a fresh install, long press the app icon to reach the Hush settings. Accounts that already exist aren't affected.

- `Suppress screenshot notification`, a new patch with its switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. Telegram stops telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats.

- `Unlock Premium features`, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram on your phone treats your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits stay the same.

- `Bypass channel restrictions`, in Privacy and off by default. Channels and chats that turn off forwarding, copying and saving let you do all three. Their stories open up too, so you can share and screenshot them, and save them wherever Telegram lets you save other stories (#52). Its second switch, `Open restricted channels`, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them (#58).

- `Bypass integrity check`, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator.

- `Send photos and videos in the best quality`, a fifth switch under `Faster downloads` in HushTelegram settings > Playback, off by default. Photos go out in HD and videos at their own size and quality without a trip to the quality button, and you can still lower one before you send it (#63).

- `Auto-forwarding rules` forwards now. Under its switch in Privacy, `Forwarding rules` lists your rules for the account you're on, and `Add rule` picks the chat to watch, the chat to send to and whether every message goes or only ones with a photo, video or file. Only messages other people send go out. A forward from any account you're signed in to never goes out again, and neither does a copy of a message a rule already sent to that chat, so rules pointing at each other can't loop, even across two accounts or through channels. Saved Messages can take forwards but isn't offered as a chat to watch. Chats you can't post in, Replies, Telegram's own account and deleted accounts aren't offered to send to, and at most 20 forwards leave a minute. Off by default.

- `Never send an uncropped photo`, under Conversations and on by default. If Telegram can't finish a crop, say the photo hasn't loaded yet or there's no memory left for the cropped copy, the editor stays open with a short note instead of sending the whole photo. Tap Done or Send again to retry, or Cancel to leave the photo uncropped. Live photos get the same check, including when the still can't be read from its file. Videos crop the way they always did.

- `My messages`, under Conversations and off by default. A group's menu at the top gets My messages, which opens the chat's search on the messages you sent there, so you can step through them or see them as a list. Channels and private chats don't get it. Morphe Manager lists it under Search (#71).

- `Text direction`, under Conversations and off by default. Select text in the message box and its menu gets Right to left and Left to right, which start each selected line with an invisible direction mark so it reads that way for everyone. Picking the other one later swaps the mark. Control character opens the list of invisible marks Telegram Desktop has, like RLM or ZWJ, and puts the one you pick where your selection was. Morphe Manager lists it in a new Writing group along with Use normal paste (#71).

- `Hide for me`, a new item in the message menu, behind its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu in Conversations, off by default. Long press a message, pick Hide for me, and it leaves the chat on this phone, its whole album with it. Nothing goes to Telegram, so everyone else still has it, and it stays out each time you open the chat. Show hidden messages, right below the switch, brings them all back, and so does turning the switch off (#71).

- `Forward as plain text` joins the message menu on its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. Pick it on a message you could forward, choose a chat, and the words land there as a brand new message from you. Bold, links and the original sender's name stay behind, and custom emoji turn into the regular emoji they stand for (#71).

- `Delete for them` is a new message menu item for your own messages in chats and groups, on its own switch below Hide for me, off by default. It deletes the message, album included, for everyone else and keeps your copy here with the "deleted" mark Keep deleted messages uses, even while that switch is off. It only shows while Telegram would still let you delete for everyone, so not on old messages in basic groups, and never in Saved Messages, secret chats, bots or channels. Clear kept messages removes those copies too (#71).

- `Lyrics and song dates`, a new patch with two switches in Playback, both off by default. `Lyrics in the music player` puts Lyrics in the player's menu. It looks the song up on lrclib.net and, when the lyrics are timed, keeps the current line in view as the song plays. `Dates on your profile songs` notes the day you add a song to your profile and shows it after the artist in your profile's song list. The days stay on this phone, so songs added earlier or from another device don't get one (#71).

- `Chat preview buttons`, under Chat list and off by default. Press and hold a chat and the menu under its preview ends with Open chat, which opens the chat the rest of the way, and Close preview, which puts the preview away (#71).

- `Screenshot selected messages` is a new switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. It puts a Screenshot button in the bar that shows while you pick messages. Tap it and the messages are saved to Pictures/Telegram as one picture, the way the chat shows them, with the wallpaper, date headers and times. Every message you picked has to be on screen. Secret chats never get a picture, and chats that don't allow saving only do when `Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving` is on (#71).

- `Keep captions with their photos`, under Conversations and on by default. When the photos you pick in the attach menu each have their own caption, unpicking the first one or dragging another photo in front of it used to put the first photo's caption on the new first photo. Now every caption stays with its own photo.

- `Folder icons on tabs` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default, that takes an app restart. Each folder tab above the chat list gets a small icon in front of its name, in the name's own color: a chat bubble for All Chats, a person, group, channel or bot for a folder of only that kind of chat, Telegram's unread and unmuted icons for folders that drop read or muted chats, and a plain folder for the rest. With a pack picked under `Folder icons`, the tabs use that pack's icon for the folder's name instead.

- `Open a chat by ID`, under Look and feel below the Show user and chat IDs switches. Type the number from a profile's ID row and it opens that person, group or channel, as long as this app has already seen it, say someone who wrote in a group you opened. Bot-style IDs like -100 followed by the channel's number work too (#71).

Fixes

- `Hide sender names when forwarding` covers the Share sheet now, and forwards to several chats at once, which still went out with the original author (#70). The Share sheet's send menu starts on Hide sender's name, and you can switch it back there. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender.

- With `Turn videos only from the full screen button` on, a video you put in full screen with the button stays sideways on 13.2 instead of standing back up as soon as you turn the phone (#27).

- `Save to Downloads` in the message menu saves every photo of an album, not just the one you long-pressed (#46).

- `Save downloaded files` no longer logs an error in its diagnostics whenever a profile photo or a sticker finishes downloading (#27).

- `Save downloaded files` no longer puts one file's contents under another file's name (#7). When two different files had the same name and size, Telegram could open the first one's file for the second instead of downloading it, and the copy in Download/Telegram came out with the wrong contents. That second file now stays out of Download/Telegram, and so does any named file Telegram finds already saved instead of downloading it. Files whose names end in .enc get copied as well, where they used to fail.

- The account rows in HushTelegram settings and the checks that tell your own accounts apart no longer log an error on 13.2.1 from Google Play. They only look at the four account slots that build has.

- Turning `UnifiedPush notifications` off, or picking another push app, when your phone couldn't save the change (a full phone, say) no longer leaves the row saying the push app ended the sign-up. Turning it back on signs up again, and a move to another app goes ahead once the old one lets go. A refusal, an address or an end the old app sends in the middle of a move can't undo it anymore, and Telegram goes back to Google's push until the new app sends its address.

- With large text, the HushTelegram settings list no longer jumps a few pixels when you go back from a search. The top bar used to come back a little shorter after a long title had to shrink to fit.

- With Telegram set to Português (Brasil), HushTelegram settings and messages come out in Portuguese. They were in English, because Telegram runs that language with no region and only the Brazilian table had Portuguese text.

- In German, the text under `Receive only mode` and `Power off accounts` says "du" like the rest of HushTelegram settings.

- A settings search while an import, an export or a diagnostic report is running shows the same rows it shows the rest of the time. Searching "Import settings" during an import used to list `Export settings` too, since that row said "Importing settings" for the moment.

- With `Hide reactions under messages` on, a new reaction to your message gets marked as seen once you scroll to it. The heart in the chat list and the reactions button in the chat used to stay there for good. Telegram's pop-up animation for that reaction no longer plays over the hidden row either (#48).

Other changes

- The telegram.org web build moves from 13.2.0 (72809) to 13.2.1 (72919). Both builds now track Telegram 13.2.1.

- `Ghost mode` lets channel reads go out now, so a channel you read on this phone shows as read on your other devices too. Nobody in a channel can see who read what, so they learn nothing. Groups and private chats stay unread everywhere else, since there the read is what people would see (#65).

- With `Ghost mode` and `No read receipts` on, opening a channel post, or one forwarded into a chat, no longer adds your view to its count. The counts still load. Turning on `Hide online status`, or Ghost mode while it's on, now shows you offline on every signed-in account right away instead of whenever Telegram would have timed you out (#71).

- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager shows "Signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc" on the HushTelegram source and remembers that key, so a later bundle signed with any other key, or not signed at all, gets refused instead of loaded.

Behind the scenes

- `scripts/name-table.ps1` writes a Telegram build's name table, the map from 13.1.1's names to the ones R8 gave the build. Run it again on a build that already has a table and it keeps the rows people added by hand and lets them win over anything it matched, so 72919's table comes back unchanged.

- The build signs the bundle when `HUSHTELEGRAM_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY` holds the private key (Morphe's shared `MORPHE_SIGNING_KEY` is the fallback), and refuses a key that isn't the one `morphe-signing.pub` publishes. Without one the build still works and says the bundle is unsigned. `verifyBundle` checks the signature with Morphe's own verifier and fails a bundle signed by another key, or an unsigned one when the build had a key. A release won't go out with a bundle the published key didn't sign, and the index gains `public_key`.

- `verifyBundle` fails a bundle holding any class file newer than Java 17 (major 61), which Morphe's patcher won't load. The bundle's classes are Java 8 and 11 today, so a toolchain change that crosses the line now stops the build instead of reaching Manager.

- The host test runner's Netty moves from 4.1.138.Final to 4.1.140.Final, which carries Netty's HTTP smuggling and decoder fixes. Only the tests on the build machine use it. Nothing in the bundle does.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer. It's the same version 0.0.24 needed.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram. If you already have it, refresh the source. From this release on Morphe Manager shows it as signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc.
3. Get Telegram 13.2.1. From Google Play that's `org.telegram.messenger` with version code 72911, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. telegram.org's build is `org.telegram.messenger.web` with version code 72919, but the [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) there already hands out 13.2.2, which this release doesn't cover yet. Get 13.2.1 from Telegram's own [Telegram APKs for Android](https://t.me/TAndroidAPK) channel instead. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.24? Patch the same 13.2.1 build you used last time (telegram.org users move up from 13.2.0) and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. On phones where Firebase notifications don't come through, try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. It turns those two on for you unless you've set them yourself.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The Ways in section on that page decides which of those (plus the side menu row and the icon shortcut) stay.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

What was checked

All 2327 runtime tests passed locally, and all 664 patch tests passed too (166 unit tests and 498 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 82 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.1 (version code 72919) and to the Google Play build of 13.2.1 (version code 72911). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, resource table, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S22, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings and the Changed switches page. That's 22 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either.
